tools.name: ripples_launch_agent
tools.description: Creates an agent on Ripples: its token and market, its NFT collection, and the contract that holds its money. The contract is the launch's creator, so the creator's share of every trade fee (30% of the 1% fee on mainnet), and any creatorChargePercent set here, become the agent's working capital. The spending limits and the charge are fixed in this call and nobody, including the creator, can raise them afterwards. This is permanent: there is no pause, and losing the operator key ends the agent for good. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". It spends the runway, in WETH, and the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. One launch runs at a time, and a repeat launch answers with the last one's treasury, or its transaction, until previousLaunch names it. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

name.description: The project's name, used for the token and the collection, at most 32 bytes.

symbol.description: The ticker, 1 to 10 letters or digits, written in capitals on chain.

image.description: A public link to the token's image, at most 512 bytes. The token carries it on chain.

description.description: What the project is, at most 2,048 bytes. The token carries it on chain.

website.description: A link to the project's website, at most 256 bytes. The token carries it on chain.

x.description: A link to the project's X profile, at most 256 bytes. The token carries it on chain.

mintPrice.description: Price per NFT, in the market's asset.

collectionSupply.description: How many pieces the collection holds, at least 1.

artworkBaseUri.description: Where the finished artwork lives, with a trailing slash.

creatorChargePercent.description: An extra charge on every trade in the agent's market, 0 to 10 percent in steps of 0.01, paid in full to its contract on top of the 1% trade fee. Fixed for good at launch. Leave it out for 0.

runway.description: What goes into the agent's contract, in the market's asset. Covers the launch fee and is what the agent works with until its market earns.

operator.description: The wallet that runs the agent: the only key that can ever spend from its contract, fixed for the life of the launch. Use a key that holds nothing else and run the agent from a server configured with it, since this server's wallet also funds the runway. An address that cannot sign leaves the agent inoperable.

dailySpend.description: Most it can spend in a day. Buys, mints and payouts share it. Give 0, with perCallSpend 0, for an agent that never spends.

perCallSpend.description: Most it can spend in one transaction, at most dailySpend. At least the mint price, or it can never mint.

dailySell.description: Most of its own token it can sell in a day. Leave it out and it can never sell.

dailyMint.description: Pieces it can mint a day. Leave it out and it can never mint.

items.description: An address the agent may pay, fixed for good at launch.

payees.description: The only addresses it will ever be able to pay, at most 8. Leave it out and it can pay nobody.

previousLaunch.description: The treasury address, or the transaction hash, this server's last launch answered with. Until a call names it, a repeat launch is refused and answers with it.

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": creating an agent cannot be undone. Its charter's limits and payees can never change, there is no pause, and losing the operator key ends the agent for good.

tools.name: ripples_agent_buy
tools.description: Buys the agent's own token on its own market, into its own contract. It spends the agent's money, inside the daily and per-transaction limits, and the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

amount.description: How much of the market's asset to spend.

minReceived.description: The fewest tokens to accept. Leave it out for 99% of what the market quotes now.

tools.name: ripples_agent_sell
tools.description: Sells the agent's own token back into its market. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. An agent launched without dailySell can never sell, and a sell from it, or one above what is left of today's ceiling, is refused before anything is sent. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

amount.description: How much of its own token to sell.

minReceived.description: The least of the market's asset to accept. Leave it out for 99% of what the market quotes now.

tools.name: ripples_agent_mint
tools.description: Mints from the agent's own collection. The pieces stay with the agent, and the mint funds its own market like anyone else's. It spends the agent's money on the pieces, inside its limits, and the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

quantity.description: How many pieces to mint, 1 to 20, the most the collection mints at once.

minRouted.description: The least of the mint's payment, in the market's asset, that must reach the agent's market. Leave it out for 99% of what the mint routes now.

tools.name: ripples_agent_pay
tools.description: Pays one of the addresses the charter published, from the agent's money and inside its limits. Any other address is refused. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

to.description: One of the payees the charter published at launch. Any other address is refused.

amount.description: How much of the market's asset to pay.

tools.name: ripples_agent_note
tools.description: Writes an entry in the agent's public run log, beside the transactions it describes. The text is committed as a hash and the `uri` is published next to it, so an entry with no `uri` is a dated digest nobody can read back. Pass a link to what the entry is about. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

text.description: The entry's text, committed on chain as its hash.

uri.description: A link to what the entry is about, at most 200 bytes.

tools.name: ripples_agent_claim
tools.description: Takes in what the launch has earned: the creator's share of every trade and the collection's share of every mint. The contract pays only the agent, whichever wallet sends the claim. What is owed is read first, and with nothing owed it is refused as nothing_to_claim before anything is sent. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

tools.name: ripples_agent_claim_vested
tools.description: Takes in the token slice the agent's own mints earned it. Separate from the fee claim because it only pays out once the market has reached its target, and a claim with nothing vested would otherwise fail the other one. How it claims follows how the launch keyed its vest, which ripples_agent_status says in capabilities.vestKeyedToPieces: when true, give tokenIds, pieces the treasury holds, and it takes in the slices tied to them; when false, leave tokenIds out. ripples_launch_agent keys an agent's vest to its wallet, so leave tokenIds out for the agents it makes. A claim made the other way is refused before anything is sent, saying which way to claim. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

tokenIds.description: Ids of pieces the treasury holds, to take in their slices when the launch keyed its vest to the pieces (capabilities.vestKeyedToPieces true). Leave it out when the vest is keyed to the wallet, as it is for an agent ripples_launch_agent made.

tools.name: ripples_agent_status
tools.description: What the agent may do, what is left of today's limits, what its treasury holds (budget.balance to spend, and budget.tokens, the most of its own token a sell can take), what its market and collection owe it now (owed, which ripples_agent_claim takes in), and the addresses of its launch. capabilities.vestKeyedToPieces says how its launch keyed its vest: true, so ripples_agent_claim_vested takes tokenIds; false, so it takes none; null when that cannot be told. capabilities.objectVesting says whether the treasury's contract can claim a vest keyed to pieces. owed or capabilities is left out when it cannot be read just then. With RIPPLES_TREASURY set, it needs no key. With no agent named, it says how to name or launch one.

tools.name: ripples_agent_activity
tools.description: Everything the agent has done, newest first, read from its own contract. With RIPPLES_TREASURY set, it needs no key.

limit.description: The most entries to answer with, 1 to 200. Leave it out for 25.

fromBlock.description: The block to read back to, asked for 10,000 blocks a request. Leave it out for the last 50,000 blocks; 0 reads back to the agent's launch, where its history starts.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_join
tools.description: Adds money to one side's opening buy, in what that side is priced in. Until publicUntil a side accepts more than its target, up to a quarter of it per wallet; after that it takes only what it still needs. On Solana each contribution is at least 0.01 SOL, or 10,000,000 base units of the asset the side is priced in, unless it fills the side. It spends the amount plus the network fee. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

side.description: The chain whose side this acts on: robinhood, arc or solana.

amount.description: How much to add: ETH on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Arc, and on Solana SOL, or the asset the side is priced in, in that asset's decimal places.

payWith.description: quote pays the side's own quote, after an approval where that quote is a token. native pays the chain's own coin on a side that wraps it into its quote, as Robinhood Chain's testnet wraps ETH into WETH. Where the quote is the chain's own coin, as ETH is on Robinhood Chain mainnet, both pay it with no approval. On Arc, USDC is the gas as well as the quote. Leave it out for quote.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_withdraw
tools.description: Takes money back from a side that is still filling, before its deadline, in what that side is priced in. Withdrawals stop in the last five minutes before publicUntil. On Solana what stays in must be at least 0.01 SOL, or 10,000,000 base units of the asset the side is priced in, unless all of it comes back. It costs only the network fee. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

side.description: The chain whose side this acts on: robinhood, arc or solana.

amount.description: How much to take back, in ETH on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Arc, and on Solana SOL, or the asset the side is priced in, in that asset's decimal places. Leave it out to take back everything this wallet put in.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_status
tools.description: Where a Crosscurrent stands, in the words ripples.run shows, with the chains it runs on (`chains`), each side checked against its chain (`verified`) and what this server's wallets hold in it (`you`), each deposit in what its side is priced in. `view.legs.solana.quote` names what the Solana side is priced in.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_positions
tools.description: Every Crosscurrent side a wallet has money in, and whether each can be withdrawn, claimed or refunded. Reads this server's wallets, or the addresses given, which need no key.

evm.description: An EVM wallet to read in place of this server's own, on every rail it holds a position on.

solana.description: A Solana wallet to read in place of this server's own.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_claim
tools.description: Claims the tokens a joined wallet is owed on each opened side. Money paid in above a side's target comes back with them, in what that side is priced in. It costs only the network fee. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

side.description: One chain of the Crosscurrent's set, or all of them. Leave it out for all.

evm.description: The EVM wallet to settle for, on each EVM chain of the set.

solana.description: The Solana wallet to settle for.

for.description: Claim or refund for these wallets rather than this server's own.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_refund
tools.description: Sends a joined wallet's money back from each side that did not open, in what that side is priced in. It costs only the network fee. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

side.description: One chain of the Crosscurrent's set, or all of them. Leave it out for all.

evm.description: The EVM wallet to settle for, on each EVM chain of the set.

solana.description: The Solana wallet to settle for.

for.description: Claim or refund for these wallets rather than this server's own.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_take_back_deposit
tools.description: Sends each side's launch deposit back to whoever created that side: the creating wallet, or for an agent's side its treasury. A side pays its deposit back once it has opened or can no longer open, and only to its creator, whichever wallet sends the call. It costs only the network fee. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

side.description: One chain of the Crosscurrent's set, or all of them. Leave it out for all.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_agent_remaining
tools.description: What a Crosscurrent agent can still do on each chain it runs on, read from its contracts, under `remaining`: what is left of its spending limit there, in that chain's quote (`spend`), and whether it has been stopped (`stopped`). On its EVM chain it also says what is left of today's selling limit (`sell`) and how many of its tokens it may sell (`sellableTokens`). A side not created yet is null. On Solana, `spendWindow` gives the state of the agent's rolling 24-hour spending window; in this release it is upgrade_required on both networks, and `spend` there is 0, as the pinned Solana program has no such window. It needs no key.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_agent_migrate_spend_window
tools.description: Adds a rolling 24-hour spending window to the Solana side of a Crosscurrent agent that has none. It costs the network fee and the window account's rent, from this server's Solana wallet, and the agent then waits 24 hours before it spends on Solana again. In this release it is refused as spend_window_upgrade_required on both networks, before anything is signed, as the pinned Solana program has no such window. It signs with the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY), and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_agent_buy
tools.description: Buys the agent's own token on one chain with the agent's funds, inside its limits. Refused before the market opens, in its first seconds, and after the agent is stopped. Run it from a server whose keys are the agent's operator keys. In this release a Solana side is refused as spend_window_upgrade_required, before anything is signed. It spends the agent's funds, and the network fee from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

side.description: The chain whose side this acts on: robinhood, arc or solana.

amount.description: How much of the agent's funds to spend: ETH on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Arc, SOL on Solana.

minTokensOut.description: The fewest tokens to accept. Leave it out for 99% of what the market quotes now.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_agent_pay
tools.description: Pays one of the addresses the agent's charter fixed at creation, from the agent's funds and inside its limits. Run it from a server whose keys are the agent's operator keys. In this release a Solana side is refused as spend_window_upgrade_required, before anything is signed. The network fee comes from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

side.description: The chain whose side this acts on: robinhood, arc or solana.

to.description: One of the charter's payees on that chain.

amount.description: How much to pay: ETH on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Arc, SOL on Solana.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_agent_note
tools.description: Writes an entry in the agent's public log on one chain: the keccak256 hash of the entry's text, and a link to it. Pass the text and the server hashes its UTF-8 bytes, as ripples_agent_note does, or pass that hash as digest. Run it from a server whose keys are the agent's operator keys. It costs only the network fee. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

id.description: The Crosscurrent's id, the last part of its ripples.run/crosscurrent link.

side.description: The chain whose side this acts on: robinhood, arc or solana.

text.description: The entry's text. Only its hash is written on chain. Give this or digest.

digest.description: The keccak256 hash of the entry's UTF-8 text, 0x and 64 hexadecimal characters. Give this or text.

uri.description: A link to what the entry is about, at most 200 bytes.

tools.name: ripples_crosscurrent_progress
tools.description: Where a Crosscurrent launch stands: each market's phase as Ripples last observed it, the token on each chain, and its page. Nothing is signed.

launch.description: The 0x id at the end of the launch page's address, in lowercase.

tools.name: ripples_crosscurrent_resume
tools.description: Finishes a launch this server's wallet reserved but did not send: it signs for ownership if that is still owed, waits for Ripples to create the bridges, then pays for the launch and records it. Use it after a launch answered launch_interrupted or launch_reverted. If the chain shows the launch already went through, the answer carries its page; follow it with ripples_crosscurrent_progress. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

launch.description: The 0x id at the end of the launch page's address, in lowercase.

wait.description: Whether to wait for every market to open before answering. Leave it out to wait.

tools.name: ripples_crosscurrent_name_solana_payout
tools.description: Names the Solana wallet a launch's creator share of the Solana market's fees goes to: this server's Solana wallet, which signs one message. It cannot be changed afterwards, so it requires acknowledge: "permanent". Until a wallet is named, the fees wait on the launch. It signs with the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) and signs in with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, the wallet that reserved the launch, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

launch.description: The 0x id at the end of the launch page's address, in lowercase.

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": the creator's share of the Solana market's fees goes to this wallet for good.

tools.name: ripples_collect
tools.description: Takes in everything this server's wallet is owed on Robinhood Chain, in one pass: the creator fee of each of its launches, per asset, and of a launch whose fee is pledged to a delivery bond, through the bond's fee split (before the bond's deadline the pledged share of what it pays in ETH or WETH goes into the bond and the rest to this wallet; after it, all of it to this wallet); the proceeds of each collection it created; the token slice its mints vested, whether the vest belongs to the wallet or to the pieces it holds; holder periods the publisher could not push to it; and a paired launch's stock rewards. Each claim is read first and sent only with something to pay, and every contract pays the wallet whichever address sends the claim. It answers with what was sent and what was skipped, and why. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, once per claim sent. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

launches.description: Launch token addresses to collect from instead of this wallet's own launches: a minter names the launches it minted into. Holder periods and stock rewards are collected either way.

tools.name: ripples_bond_terms
tools.description: Returns the terms for delivery bonds on Ripples launches on this server's network. A delivery bond is money a creator locks behind a dated, public promise about their launch. Shipped, the bond service whose contracts hold the money on Robinhood Chain, pays it out once the promise is judged: if the verifier the creator named confirms delivery, the bond is released to the creator; if the promise is missed, it is paid to the launch's holders. Whatever the outcome, Shipped adds the verdict to the record it keeps for the creator's wallet. The answer says whether bonds are offered. It gives the addresses of Shipped's registry, its fee split factory and its AI council, which judges any bond posted without a verifier. It also gives the asset bonds are held in, the fee Shipped takes from what a bond releases to its creator, the earliest and latest deadlines allowed, and the default terms used when a call leaves them out. Bonds are offered on Robinhood Chain mainnet and its testnet. It needs no key.

tools.name: ripples_launch_with_bond
tools.description: Launches a token from this server's wallet on Robinhood Chain and posts a delivery bond behind it. A delivery bond is money a creator locks behind a dated, public promise about their launch. Shipped, the bond service whose contracts hold the money on Robinhood Chain, pays it out once the promise is judged: if the verifier the creator named confirms delivery, the bond is released to the creator; if the promise is missed, it is paid to the launch's holders. Whatever the outcome, Shipped adds the verdict to the record it keeps for the creator's wallet. The wallet becomes the launch's creator, and its creator fee goes to the wallet. The deposit is locked in the bond, and with pledgePercent that share of the creator fee paid out before the deadline goes into the bond. The bond is held in WETH: on the testnet the deposit comes from the wallet's WETH, and on a market that settles in ETH the wallet wraps whatever WETH it lacks from its ETH. If the call names no verifier, Shipped's AI council judges the bond. If nobody rules within seven days after the deadline, the bond is paid to the token's holders. The arguments, the wallet's balances and Shipped's contracts are checked before the first transaction is signed. If the call stops after the launch was sent, it answers Bond unfinished, Unconfirmed when the launch itself was not seen to confirm, or Check the launch when the launch confirmed but the new token could not be read from its receipt, each with a resume value. Call again with that resume to finish the bond; steps that already confirmed are not sent again. To prevent an accidental second launch, a new launch after one is refused until previousLaunch passes the last one's token or transaction, and the refusal says what to pass. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". From this server's wallet it spends the launch fee, any opening buy and the deposit, in ETH on mainnet (any WETH the wallet already holds goes to the deposit first) and in WETH on the testnet, plus the network fee in ETH for each transaction it sends. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

name.description: The token's name, at most 32 bytes. Required unless resume is given.

symbol.description: The ticker, 1 to 10 letters or digits, written in capitals on chain. Required unless resume is given.

image.description: A public link to the token's image, at most 512 bytes. The token carries it on chain. Required unless resume is given.

description.description: What the project is, at most 2,048 bytes. The token carries it on chain.

website.description: A link to the project's website, at most 256 bytes.

x.description: A link to the project's X profile, at most 256 bytes.

telegram.description: A link to the project's Telegram, at most 256 bytes.

creatorChargePercent.description: An extra charge on every trade, 0 to 10 percent in steps of 0.01, paid to this wallet on top of the 1% trade fee. It is set at launch and cannot be changed later. On the testnet a pledge needs it above 0, since the launch pays its creator nothing else.

openingBuy.description: A buy into the market in the launch's own transaction, in ETH on mainnet and in WETH on the testnet.

title.description: The bond's title: one line of at most 96 bytes, shown wherever the bond is shown. Required unless resume finishes a bond already posted.

milestone.description: What will be delivered and how anyone can tell, at most 2,048 bytes, stored on chain. Write it so a holder and the verifier read it the same way. Required unless resume finishes a bond already posted.

deadline.description: When the milestone is due, such as 2026-12-31T23:59:00Z: at least 25 minutes and less than three years away. Required unless resume finishes a bond already posted.

verifier.description: The address of whoever judges delivery: a person, a team, or a contract such as a multisig. Leave it out and Shipped's AI council judges the bond; ripples_bond_terms gives its address. Each of the council's three AI judges reads the milestone and the evidence the creator posts, and the council rules only when two of them agree. The verifier cannot be this server's wallet, because that is the wallet posting the bond. A verifier can confirm delivery at any time, but can rule that the milestone was missed only after the deadline has passed.

deposit.description: What is locked in the bond, which holds it as WETH: on mainnet the wallet wraps whatever WETH it lacks from its ETH, and on the testnet it comes from the wallet's WETH. 0 is allowed when pledgePercent is set. Required unless resume finishes a bond already posted.

pledgePercent.description: The share of the creator fee paid out before the deadline that goes into the bond, 0.01 to 100. Leave it out, or 0, to pledge none.

token.description: The launch's token, as the earlier answer's resume names it.

launchTransaction.description: The launch's transaction, as an earlier Unconfirmed or Check the launch answer's resume names it.

fromBlock.description: The launch's block, as the earlier answer's resume names it.

bondId.description: The bond already posted for the launch, as the earlier answer's resume names it.

postTransaction.description: The transaction that posts the bond, as the earlier answer's resume names it when that transaction was not seen to confirm.

resume.description: The resume value from an earlier Bond unfinished, Unconfirmed or Check the launch answer. Pass it to finish that bonded launch; the launch itself is not sent again.

previousLaunch.description: The token address or transaction hash from this server's last bonded launch. To prevent an accidental second launch, a new launch is refused until it passes this value, and the refusal says what to pass.

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": a posted bond's terms and deposit are locked until its verdict, and a pledged fee stays pledged while it is open.

tools.name: ripples_pledge_to_bond
tools.description: Pledges a share of a launch's creator fee to a delivery bond that this server's wallet posted for the launch. That share of the fee paid out in ETH or WETH before the bond's deadline goes into the bond, and the rest goes to this wallet. Any part of the fee paid in the launch's own token goes to this wallet in full. A delivery bond is money a creator locks behind a dated, public promise about their launch. Shipped, the bond service whose contracts hold the money on Robinhood Chain, pays it out once the promise is judged: if the verifier the creator named confirms delivery, the bond is released to the creator; if the promise is missed, it is paid to the launch's holders. Whatever the outcome, Shipped adds the verdict to the record it keeps for the creator's wallet. If the bond has no fee split yet (the contract that divides the fee between the bond and the wallet), the tool creates one first. Only the launch's current fee recipient can pledge, and while the bond is open nobody can send the fee anywhere else. Everything is checked before the first signature and again right before the pledge is signed. If the launch's fee is already pledged to this bond, the tool sends nothing. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". It sends at most two transactions and pays only their network fees, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

token.description: The launch's token, whose creator fee is pledged.

bondId.description: The bond's id on Shipped's registry, as returned by ripples_bond_status or ripples_launch_with_bond.

pledgePercent.description: The share of the creator fee pledged to the bond, 0.01 to 100. If the bond already has a fee split, give the share it was made with.

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": a pledged fee stays pledged while the bond is open.

tools.name: ripples_reclaim_bond_fee
tools.description: Pays out a launch's creator fee held for its delivery bond, and points the fee back from the bond once the bond is decided, meaning it is no longer open: ruled, under appeal or settled. Before the bond's deadline it has the launch's hook pay the bond's fee split what it is owed and the split pay out: the pledged share of what it pays in ETH or WETH goes into the bond, and the rest to the split's creator. After the deadline, or once the bond is decided, the split pays everything it holds and is owed to its creator. On the testnet it pays out in WETH. On a market in ETH it pays out in ETH, or in WETH if the creator's wallet is a contract that cannot receive ETH. Once the bond is decided, it also points the launch's creator fee back at this server's wallet. Anyone may pay a split out; only the fee split's creator can point the fee back. It sends at most five transactions and pays only their network fees, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

token.description: The launch's token, whose creator fee was pledged to a bond.

bondId.description: The bond whose fee split to collect from. Leave it out for the bond the launch's fee goes to now; give it after the fee was pointed back.

tools.name: ripples_withdraw_bond
tools.description: Withdraws what Shipped's registry holds for this server's wallet. A delivery bond is money a creator locks behind a dated, public promise about their launch. Shipped, the bond service whose contracts hold the money on Robinhood Chain, pays it out once the promise is judged: if the verifier the creator named confirms delivery, the bond is released to the creator; if the promise is missed, it is paid to the launch's holders. Whatever the outcome, Shipped adds the verdict to the record it keeps for the creator's wallet. Once a bond is settled in its creator's favor, the registry holds it for the creator, or holds the creator's share when the outcome divides the bond. It also holds anything else credited to the wallet, such as a verifier's fee, and pays all of it out as WETH. On mainnet the tool unwraps it to ETH in a second transaction; on the testnet it stays WETH, because the testnet's WETH cannot be unwrapped. It pays only the network fees, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

tools.name: ripples_bond_status
tools.description: Reads where a launch's delivery bond stands on Robinhood Chain: its status and verdict, its deadline, what it holds, who judges it, and whether the launch's creator fee is pledged to it. A delivery bond is money a creator locks behind a dated, public promise about their launch. Shipped, the bond service whose contracts hold the money on Robinhood Chain, pays it out once the promise is judged: if the verifier the creator named confirms delivery, the bond is released to the creator; if the promise is missed, it is paid to the launch's holders. Whatever the outcome, Shipped adds the verdict to the record it keeps for the creator's wallet. With RIPPLES_SHIPPED_API set, it adds what Shipped's own API says: the bond's current phase, when the next phase starts, and whether Shipped counts it as the launch's own bond, meaning it was posted by the launch's creator while the creator fee still went to them. With no bondId it reads the bond the fee is pledged to, or else the newest bond the launch's creator posted, searching from the launch's own block. A search that runs past 45 seconds is stopped and answers bond_search_timeout. It needs no key.

bondId.description: A bond's id, to read that bond rather than the launch's newest.

fromBlock.description: The block to start searching from. A bond posted before it is not found, so use the launch's own block or an earlier one.

tools.name: ripples_bind_token
tools.description: Makes a token this server's wallet holds an agent: registers it as an ERC-8004 agent through the ERC-8217 adapter on Robinhood Chain, so whoever holds the token controls the agent, and control moves with a sale. Answers the agent's number, its 8004scan page and the ripples.run link that launches a market from it, whose creator income then goes to whoever holds the token. A token the wallet does not hold is refused before anything is sent. Each call makes another agent, so bind a token once. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663): the chain the piece is on, and its markets with it.

nft.description: The piece's collection, an ERC-721 contract.

tokenId.description: The piece's number in its collection, in decimal digits as text, such as "2".

tools.name: ripples_pin_wake
tools.description: Points the creator income of a launch this server's wallet made at a piece, so the income is paid to whoever holds the piece and goes with it when the piece is sold. Creates the piece's payee first where it does not exist yet. This is permanent: nobody, this wallet included, can point the income anywhere else afterward. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". Refused before anything is sent when this wallet does not receive the launch's creator fee, when the income already goes to a piece or to holders, or when the piece has no holder on that chain. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, for one or two transactions. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663): the chain the piece is on, and its markets with it.

nft.description: The piece's collection, an ERC-721 contract.

tokenId.description: The piece's number in its collection, in decimal digits as text, such as "2".

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": the launch's creator income follows the piece for good.

tools.name: ripples_wake
tools.description: What a piece's wake holds on Robinhood Chain or Base: the markets launched from it, what is owed now, read from the chain, what has been paid and the last payout, who holds the piece, and the payee that pays it. Amounts are in each currency's smallest unit, with its symbol and decimals. Answers wake: null when no market pays the piece directly and the Ripples API lists no split that pays it; read a split you know with ripples_wake_split. Needs no key.

nft.description: The piece's collection, an ERC-721 contract.

tokenId.description: The piece's number in its collection, in decimal digits as text, such as "2".

launches.description: Launch tokens to count beside the markets the Ripples API lists for the piece, each checked on chain.

tools.name: ripples_release_wake
tools.description: Pays everything a piece's markets owe it to whoever holds the piece now. A holder share that owes the creator's part to the piece is brought up to date first, then the piece's payee pays out each currency it holds. Anyone may send it, and it pays only the holder; nothing owed sends nothing. A step the chain refuses before anything is signed for it, such as a currency the holder cannot take, is answered in skipped and the rest still goes out. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, once per transaction sent. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

nft.description: The piece's collection, an ERC-721 contract.

tokenId.description: The piece's number in its collection, in decimal digits as text, such as "2".

launches.description: Launch tokens to count beside the markets the Ripples API lists for the piece, each checked on chain.

tools.name: ripples_share_wake
tools.description: Shares the creator income of a launch this server's wallet made between up to 256 pieces on Robinhood Chain. Each piece is owed its part, paid to whoever holds the piece when it is paid out, so a piece's part goes with it when it is sold. Creates the split for the pieces first where it does not exist yet. This is permanent: nobody, this wallet included, can change which pieces share the income or in what parts. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". Refused before anything is sent when a piece has no holder on that chain, when a piece is named twice or with a weight of 0, when this wallet does not receive the launch's creator fee, or when the income already goes to a piece, to pieces or to holders. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, for one or two transactions. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663): the chain the piece is on, and its markets with it.

nft.description: The piece's collection, an ERC-721 contract.

tokenId.description: The piece's number in its collection, in decimal digits as text, such as "2".

weight.description: The piece's parts of the wake. Each piece is owed its weight over the total of every piece's weight. Leave it out for 1.

pieces.description: The pieces that share the wake, up to 256, each named once and in any order. The split keeps them ascending by collection, then by token id.

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": the launch's creator income is shared by these pieces for good.

tools.name: ripples_wake_split
tools.description: What a split's wake holds on Robinhood Chain or Base: each piece with its weight and index, who holds it, what it is owed now, read from the chain, what it has been paid and its last payout, and the markets that pay the split. Amounts are in each currency's smallest unit, with its symbol and decimals. Needs no key.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663) or Base (8453): the chain the piece is on, and its markets with it.

split.description: The split: the contract that shares a launch's creator income between its pieces, as ripples_share_wake answered it.

launches.description: Launch tokens to count beside the markets the Ripples API lists for the split, each checked on chain.

tools.name: ripples_release_split
tools.description: Pays each piece of a split its part of the income the split receives, to whoever holds the piece now. A holder share that owes the split the creator's part is brought up to date first, then the split pays out each currency, at most 64 pieces a transaction. Anyone may send it, and it pays only the pieces' holders. Answers each piece paid and each piece that could not be paid, whose part stays owed to it. A piece with no holder, or one the split itself holds, is listed without being sent, and nothing owed sends nothing. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, once per transaction sent. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663) or Base (8453): the chain the piece is on, and its markets with it.

split.description: The split: the contract that shares a launch's creator income between its pieces, as ripples_share_wake answered it.

indexes.description: The pieces to pay, by their index in the split as ripples_wake_split lists them. Leave it out to pay every piece.

launches.description: Launch tokens to count beside the markets the Ripples API lists for the split, each checked on chain.
